errors.text_span: AUD_USD с 4%, ETH_USD със 4% и "Other" със 6%
errors.evidence: Description inaccurately states AUD_USD and ETH_USD percentages as 4% when the figure shows AUD_USD as 3.9% and ETH_USD as 3.8%.
The description does not mention the primary purpose of the chart or its relevance to 'Портфейл 5'.
The description does not specify that there are two pie charts displayed, mixing the information of the two in an unclear manner.
Inaccurately describes '4EN' as '4%', when it is actually displayed as 1%.
